summary: Memory is advisory retrieval context only. Mutable task state belongs exclusively to tasks/tracker.json; retrieved memory must never override controller status, branch, allowed files, validators, or lifecycle transitions.

Each implementation, correctness-review, security-review, and release stage runs as a fresh Zoo new_task child. Specialist children record only their own taskctl transition, return through attempt_completion, and terminate; the Orchestrator alone routes the next stage.

Default agentic task size is 1-3 non-state source files. Four to five files requires explicit justification; more than five must be split before submit/complete. Small diffs improve review quality, token use, and evidence reuse.

Reuse passing focused validator evidence only when the controller-recorded changed scope and deterministic source fingerprint still match. Source drift invalidates reuse and triggers only the affected focused validators, never broad reassurance testing.
The Release Manager may commit closure evidence, push the task branch, and open or update the feature-to-dev PR, but merge remains a human action. Automated agents must not auto-merge delivery PRs.

New feature or capability work uses feat/<task-id>-<short-slug>. Fixes use fix/, maintenance uses chore/. Existing historical or in-flight branches keep their declared names; branch naming is forward-only.
